options.query: | rest /services/data/indexes | search disabled=0 title!="_*" | eval Events=tonumber(totalEventCount) | stats sum(Events) AS value
index=_internal source=*metrics.log group=per_sourcetype_thruput | stats dc(series) AS value

| rest /servicesNS/-/search/saved/searches splunk_server=local | search disabled=0 is_scheduled=1 | eval project_detection=if(match(title,"^(D[0-9]{2}|P1-[A-Z][0-9]{2}|OPS01)\s+-"),1,0) | where project_detection=1 | dedup title | stats count AS value

index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler status=success savedsearch_name=* | eval Results=tonumber(result_count) | where Results>0 AND match(savedsearch_name,"^(D[0-9]{2}|P1-[A-Z][0-9]{2}|OPS01)\s+-") | stats count AS value
index=_internal source=*metrics.log group=per_index_thruput series!="_*" | timechart span=1h sum(kb) AS KB BY series limit=8 useother=t
| rest /services/data/indexes | search disabled=0 title!="_*" | eval Events=tonumber(totalEventCount) | sort - Events | table title Events | rename title AS Index

index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler status=success savedsearch_name=* | eval Hits=tonumber(result_count) | where Hits>0 AND match(savedsearch_name,"^(D[0-9]{2}|P1-[A-Z][0-9]{2}|OPS01)\s+-") | stats sum(Hits) AS Hits BY savedsearch_name | sort - Hits | head 10 | rename savedsearch_name AS Detection

index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler savedsearch_name=* | where match(savedsearch_name,"^(D[0-9]{2}|P1-[A-Z][0-9]{2}|OPS01)\s+-") | eval Scheduler_Status=upper(status) | stats count AS Executions BY Scheduler_Status | sort - Executions
index=_internal source=*metrics.log group=per_host_thruput | stats sum(kb) AS KB BY series | sort - KB | head 10 | rename series AS Host

| makeresults count=4 | streamstats count AS row | eval Playbook=case(row=1,"PB02",row=2,"PB03",row=3,"PB04",row=4,"PB05"), Scope=case(row=1,"Reconnaissance response",row=2,"Web exploitation response",row=3,"Identity response",row=4,"Persistence and C2 response"), Validation=case(row=1,"FUNCTIONALLY COMPLETE",row=2,"CP2 AND CP3 VERIFIED",row=3,"IRP2 AND IRP3 VERIFIED",row=4,"CRP1 THROUGH CRP4 VERIFIED") | table Playbook Scope Validation

| rest /services/data/indexes | search disabled=0 title!="_*" | eval Total_Events=tonumber(totalEventCount), Size_MB=round(tonumber(currentDBSizeMB),2) | sort - Total_Events | table title Total_Events Size_MB maxTime frozenTimePeriodInSecs | rename title AS Index maxTime AS Latest_Event frozenTimePeriodInSecs AS Retention_Seconds

index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler status=success savedsearch_name=* | eval Results=tonumber(result_count) | where Results>0 AND match(savedsearch_name,"^(D[0-9]{2}|P1-[A-Z][0-9]{2}|OPS01)\s+-") | table _time savedsearch_name Results run_time | rename _time AS Time savedsearch_name AS Detection run_time AS Runtime_Seconds | sort - Time | head 20
